text: The controlled reoperation of multipurpose dams for flood control in South Korea is an initiative led by K-water to proactively manage flood risks through dynamic dam operations. This approach utilizes digital twins for real-time simulation and visualization of downstream risks, enabling precise discharge decisions across a coordinated network of dams. The initiative is part of South Korea's broader water resources management strategy, aiming to mitigate flooding and enhance drought resilience under climate change-driven extreme weather conditions.
